en-US.name: Cram Vault: AI Lecture Notes
en-US.subtitle: Flashcards, Quiz & Exam Prep
en-US.promotional_text: Record lectures, get AI flashcards & quizzes in seconds. Built for college, AP, SAT, MCAT, NCLEX, LSAT & Bar Exam prep. Study smarter tonight.
en-US.description:
Cram Vault turns every lecture into an exam-ready study vault. Record class on your iPhone, get an accurate on-device transcript, and let AI build flashcards, practice quizzes, formula sheets and a one-page cheat sheet in seconds.

WHY STUDENTS USE CRAM VAULT
• Lecture recorder + transcription that works offline and keeps audio private on your device
• AI flashcards with spaced repetition (FSRS) so you review exactly what you are about to forget
• Practice quizzes with explanations, generated from what your professor actually said
• Formula vault: capture equations from the whiteboard with your camera
• One-page cheat sheet export (PDF) for any lecture or course
• Siri, Spotlight and Action Button shortcuts: "Quiz me for my next exam"

BUILT FOR EVERY EXAM
College lectures, Organic Chemistry, Calculus, Physics and Computer Science. AP Biology, AP Chemistry, APUSH and SAT. MCAT biochemistry, psychology and CARS. NCLEX-RN pharmacology. LSAT logic and Bar Exam MBE outlines.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap record when class starts.
2. Cram Vault transcribes and highlights key concepts, formulas and exam hints.
3. Review AI flashcards and quizzes, then export your cheat sheet before the test.

PRIVACY FIRST
Recording and transcription run on-device. No account needed to start. We never sell your data.

Cram Vault Pro unlocks unlimited lectures, unlimited AI flashcards and quizzes, and cheat sheet export. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings. Terms: https://shuhratjon1010.github.io/cramvault/terms.html  Privacy: https://shuhratjon1010.github.io/cramvault/privacy.html
en-US.whats_new: Smarter Siri & Spotlight shortcuts: say “Quiz me for my next exam”. Faster flashcards and new exam guides.

Cram Vault turns every lecture into an exam-ready study vault. Record class on your iPhone, get an accurate on-device transcript, and let AI build flashcards, practice quizzes, formula sheets and a one-page cheat sheet in seconds.

WHY STUDENTS USE CRAM VAULT
• Lecture recorder + transcription that works offline and keeps audio private on your device
• AI flashcards with spaced repetition (FSRS) so you review exactly what you are about to forget
• Practice quizzes with explanations, generated from what your professor actually said
• Formula vault: capture equations from the whiteboard with your camera
• One-page cheat sheet export (PDF) for any lecture or course
• Siri, Spotlight and Action Button shortcuts: "Quiz me for my next exam"

BUILT FOR EVERY EXAM
College lectures, Organic Chemistry, Calculus, Physics and Computer Science. AP Biology, AP Chemistry, APUSH and SAT. MCAT biochemistry, psychology and CARS. NCLEX-RN pharmacology. LSAT logic and Bar Exam MBE outlines.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap record when class starts.
2. Cram Vault transcribes and highlights key concepts, formulas and exam hints.
3. Review AI flashcards and quizzes, then export your cheat sheet before the test.

PRIVACY FIRST
Recording and transcription run on-device. No account needed to start. We never sell your data.

Cram Vault Pro unlocks unlimited lectures, unlimited AI flashcards and quizzes, and cheat sheet export. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in Settings.
